# Hyperdrive

`storage.cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1` · Namespaced · [all resources](../README.md)

| Operation | Request |
|---|---|
| observe | `GET /accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs/{hyperdrive_id}` |
| create | `POST /accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs` |
| update | `PUT /accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs/{hyperdrive_id}` |
| delete | `DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/hyperdrive/configs/{hyperdrive_id}` |

References: `accountRef` → Account / ClusterAccount.

Credentials: via account.

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: storage.cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Hyperdrive
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    accountRef:
      name: <name>
    name: <name>
    origin:
      database: <database>
      password: <password>
      scheme: "postgres"
      user: <user>
```

| `forProvider.origin.host` | string |  | Defines the host (hostname or IP) of your origin database. |
| `forProvider.origin.password` | string | yes | Set the password needed to access your origin database. The API never returns this write-only value. |
| `forProvider.origin.port` | integer (int64) |  | Defines the port of your origin database. Defaults to 5432 for PostgreSQL or 3306 for MySQL if not specified. |

| `forProvider.origin.service_id` | string |  | The identifier of the Workers VPC Service to connect through. Hyperdrive will egress through the specified VPC Service to reach the origin database. |
| `forProvider.origin.user` | string | yes | Set the user of your origin database. |
| `forProvider.origin_connection_limit` | integer (int64) |  | The (soft) maximum number of connections the Hyperdrive is allowed to make to the origin database. | `managementPolicies` | []string |  | Actions the controller may take. `["*"]` (default) allows all; `["Observe"]` only reads (import without management). `Observe` is always required. Default `["*"]`. |
